title: Rollout of SGSecure in Condominiums and Private Estates
what_it_is: Rollout of SGSecure in Condominiums and Private Estates

sections.label: AEDs in HDB and condominiums
sections.summary: Home Team officers conduct house visits in HDB estates, with plans to include private estates and condominiums and pilot AEDs in selected condominiums.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To reach out to more members of the public, Home Team officers are also conducting house visits.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These visits are currently focused on Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates, but we will progressively include private estates and condominiums.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We are also planning a pilot programme to install automated external defibrillators (AEDs) in selected condominiums.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This is an extension of our Save-A-Life initiative, introduced in 2015 to enhance community response to cardiac arrest cases.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: So far, more than 2,000 AEDs have been installed in HDB blocks in 36 out of 89 constituencies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We are in the midst of identifying suitable condominiums to be part of this pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The installation of the AEDs will be packaged together with SGSecure and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR)/AED training.

sections.label: AED pilot with grassroots partners
sections.summary: For AED condominium pilots, authorities will work with grassroots advisers, neighbourhood committees and management corporations, as out-of-hospital cardiac arrest survival rate is around 5%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: For programmes like our pilots to install AEDs in condominiums, we will work closely with the relevant grassroots advisers, neighbourhood committees and condominium management corporation strata titles to reach out to residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: This is very important because the survival rate of out-of-hospital cardiac arrests in Singapore is low at around 5%.

sections.label: Bukit Batok East condominium pilot
sections.summary: A member volunteers Bukit Batok East condominiums for the pilot, with four constituencies to be identified jointly with the PA across the island.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: This may be something we want to work towards, and I, in any case, would like to volunteer the condominiums at Bukit Batok East for this programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: We intend to identify four constituencies jointly with the PA for this pilot, and these constituencies will be spread across the island.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: From these constituencies, we will need to identify suitable condominiums to be part of the pilot.
